newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela's foreign reserves fall to $16.540 bln.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's foreign reserves fall to $16.540 bln.

text.p: Venezuela's foreign reserves fell $133 million, or 0.8 percent, to $16.540 billion in the week to July 14, according to figures released by the Central Bank Friday.
Reserves were down from $16.673 billion on July 7, the bank's latest weekly bulletin of indicators showed.
Since the start of the year, reserve levels have risen $1.361 billion, or 9.0 percent.
Reserves rose $5.5 billion, or 57 percent, last year to $15.179 billion.
